copy.headline: 'We're already running out' | SNAP backlog leaves Central Texas families waiting for food aid
copy.caption: 'We're already running out' | SNAP backlog leaves Central Texas families waiting for food aid. A local mother said she struggled to keep groceries in the house while waiting for her SNAP benefits to be renewed.
